POST /api/account/login.description: 校验用户名/邮箱和密码，建立登录会话。前后端分离拿 Bearer 请另走 /connect/token。

callExamples.title: HTTP
callExamples.code:
POST /api/account/login HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:9000
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "userNameOrEmailAddress": "admin",
  "password": "***",
  "rememberMe": true
}
